paper_title: ChatDev: Communicative Agents for Software Development
core_problem: Addressing fragmented development phases, technical inconsistencies, and coding hallucinations in single-agent LLM software development.
methodology_summary: A communicative software development framework integrating multiple cooperative LLM agents across sequential subtasks and development phases.
empirical_results: ChatDev outperforms all baseline methods across all metrics, achieving higher win rates in both GPT-4 and human evaluations.
explicit_limitations: Includes risks of coding hallucinations such as repeating or fake replies, deep learning model constraints, and scarce evaluation benchmarks.
